title: Arcani recipe
description: Minimal recipe, schema major 1 (Story 1.1). Structure and types only: locked ranges live in tests/tables/ranges.tsv and are checked by the engine at compile, after parse (Story 1.3), so a schema-valid recipe can still be rejected at compile. Every property carries x-arcani-tag: hash-excluded (left out of the recipe hash), loudness-relevant (changes the rendered loudness), or none. Patterns end in $(?!\n) because Python's $ also matches before a final newline.

schema_version.description: Recipe schema version, MAJOR.MINOR. Supported major: 1.

engine_version.description: Engine version the recipe was authored for, X.Y.Z.

seed.description: Render seed, an integer from 0 to 2^53 - 1 (the largest integer a JSON number holds exactly).

rationale.description: Why the recipe sounds the way it does, with sources.

loudness_gain_db.description: Stored loudness gain in dB, written by the measure pass.

loudness_hash.description: Hash of the loudness-relevant fields the stored gain was measured for, 64 lowercase hex digits.

theta_reference.description: Theta reference layer: a carrier amplitude-modulated at the theta rate by one envelope shape (docs/signal-spec.md, Theta reference).

carrier_hz.description: Theta reference carrier frequency in Hz.

rate_hz.description: Theta rate in Hz: the envelope repeats at this rate.

am_depth_percent.description: AM depth in percent: the carrier dips to (100 - depth) percent of its peak where the envelope is 0.

shape.description: Envelope shape. custom is accepted here so that compile rejects it by name: the signal spec does not model it.

gamma_pac.description: Gamma PAC layer: a separate sine carrier amplitude-modulated at the gamma rate (docs/signal-spec.md, Gamma PAC layer). Uncoupled, the AM depth is constant for the render; with smooth_swell it follows the theta reference phase (docs/signal-spec.md, Coupling).

carrier_hz.description: Gamma PAC carrier frequency in Hz.

rate_hz.description: Gamma rate in Hz: the AM envelope repeats at this rate.

am_depth_percent.description: AM depth in percent: the carrier dips to (100 - depth) percent of its peak at each envelope trough.

carrier_wave.description: Carrier waveform. triangle and softened_square are accepted here so that compile rejects them by name: the signal spec models only the sine carrier.

coupling.description: How the AM depth follows the theta reference. uncoupled: the depth is constant and reads nothing from the theta reference. smooth_swell: the depth rises and falls once per theta cycle, peaking at coupling_phase_deg.

coupling_phase_deg.description: Coupling phase in degrees, measured on the theta reference envelope from its 0 degree point (the envelope peak); 360 is the same point as 0. Required with smooth_swell and rejected with uncoupled, at compile.

binaural.description: Binaural layer (stub chain): two pure sines, one per ear.
